corrections.why: The USGS station description on the Forest Lookouts page places the site about 21 miles northeast of Cliff and about 10 miles west of Gila Hot Springs. That fits the coordinates the FFLA list gives for the Grant County Granite Peak tower, and the record's point is more than 100 km away. Treat as a probable error until checked against a map.

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-nm-granite-peak (FFLA, Grant County, 33.19188, -108.37464, Gone). Matching is by name, county and the NGS-described area, not by register numbers, so merge only after a check. This record's coordinates look wrong; see corrections. Leads not used: a Facebook group post says the Gila tower was torn down in the 1970s to save costs, and a Trailforks page says 'You can see remnants' (its fetch returned 403, so neither can be quoted). Either could be checked by a reader before the story says anything about the site today.
